title: The timeline is the one in the mock
goal: The strip under a recording is the icon animation strip with a few bars added, and it looks nothing like the timeline the user designed. Build the timeline the mock draws: a proper transport with a scrubber and volume, a ruler in seconds, a red playhead, named tracks with clips in them, and zoom.
notes:
Intake detail (the goal as first filed, moved here by triage 2026-09-23): The bottom dock under a recording is the icon-animation timing strip (MotionStripView document mode) with flat accent bars added: a tiny centred glyph transport, no scrubber, no volume, truncated filename labels, a blue playhead, 22px lanes. The user: 'the timeline looks nothing, absolutely nothing, like the original design'. Build the timeline dock the mock draws. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?

Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: A TimelineDock replaces MotionStripView for documents with a duration; the icon timing strip is untouched for icons
Transport row as in video.html: volume, previous, large round primary play, next, current time, full-width scrubber with a large thumb, duration
Ruler in seconds (0s, 3s, 6s), a red playhead with a triangle head spanning every track
Track headers with icon and name (video, audio), clips as rounded gradient bars with the clip's name inside, 28-34px lanes, colours and spacing from the mock's inspector.css/overlays.css tokens
Zoom: Fit and steps, pinch, and the timeline scrolls
Side-by-side picture with video.html in the audit, differences listed and fixed

log.note: triage 2026-09-23: goal rewritten in plain language, the old one kept at the top of notes

video-shell.html was deleted on 2026-09-23 (task the-video-mocks-are-the-user-s-again-and-d18-is): it was the loop's own study arguing against tracks. The target is now pages/video.html, the video-*.html walkthroughs and comp-video.html, restored as the user drew them, plus UX-PATTERNS D18 (rewritten: a document with time has tracks). Where this task mentions video-shell, read video.html.

Build it from the video kit (Sources/Photonz/VideoKit, landed 2026-09-23): VideoKit.TransportBar/TransportButton/Scrubber for the transport row, TrackRow/TrackHeader(width: 84, uppercase: false for video.html's gutter)/TimeRuler/Playhead/ClipBar/KeyMark/Waveform/TransitionBand for the tracks. They take values and closures, no EditorState. Catalogue in UX-PATTERNS D18 'The video kit'; comparison page http://127.0.0.1:8791/shared/video-kit/index.html. Hover inside the kit goes through kitHover (playtestHover in the app).

pre-build review: (1) the mock's tracks are V1/V2/Title/Captions/Audio; the app has no track model yet (task tracks-you-can-add-rename-group-hide-mute-lock-a), so each timed layer is one track row named after the layer, with the mock's icon and clip colour for its kind. (2) Mock transport skip back/forward go to start/end, not frame step; arrows still step frames, so the buttons follow the mock (Go to Start / Go to End). (3) Volume has no home in the document player today: add a monitor mute (not saved in the document), speaker icon as the mock draws. (4) Mock tlbar has Select/Blade radio; there is no blade mode in the app, only B. Build a Blade mode in the dock: click a clip to cut it there. (5) Keyframe readout and Easing select in the mock's tlbar belong to the keyframe tasks and are left to them. (6) Premiere check: tracks named on the left, red playhead with head, ruler in seconds, wheel scrolls sideways, pinch zooms: all expected.

built: TimelineDock.swift replaces MotionStripView for documents with time (EditorView switch); transport from VideoKit (mute, go to start, primary play, go to end, timecodes, full-width Scrubber), local bar (Select/Blade radio, Fit/2x/4x/8x seg + zoom in, window reading, x), grid (Time + seconds ruler, track rows with kit headers at 84pt, 28pt lanes, 34pt with sound, tick gridlines, red kit Playhead over the lanes). ClipPiecesBar takes kind+height and draws the kit look (gradient per kind, name inside and kept in view when zoomed, accent ring when picked, white grips, kit TransitionBand, speed chip). Core: TimelineTrackKind + MotionStripRuler.secondTicks (TimelineDockTests). Monitor mute: EditorState.isDocumentMuted, DocumentAudioPlayer.setMuted. Wheel: sideways pans, option zooms; pinch zooms. Blade mode: click a lane cuts there.

verified: new walk the-timeline-is-the-one-in-the-mock-walk at defaults (5 real captures, blade cut gives 2 pieces); 42 recording walks + 12 timeline/icon walks green; Scripts/test.sh green except AnimatedExportWeighTests, which passed on rerun (already the p2 task the-export-size-test-fails-about-one-run-in-thre).
